caption: A close-up shows a bearded man in a dark sweater holding a black Yashica FR-I camera with both hands, the body centered on a mount against a near-black background. Two steady bright reflections glow on the lens front, and the YASHICA and FRI markings stay legible throughout. The viewer's-left hand is the moving element, its index finger resting curled on the top plate beside the FRI label at the start of the visible segment. As the clip progresses, that hand rotates slightly and the index finger lifts and extends upward, its tip rising toward the top-left knob area of the camera body. This small rotation exposes a silver strap lug at the left edge that had been hidden by the hand. The viewer's-right hand, the gripping fingers, and the camera body remain essentially stationary, the fixed framing keeping the man's chin and the mount in place.
